cases.title: Case A — 1:1:2 building
cases.summary: Isolated 1:1:2 building, velocity field (split-fibre hot wire).

frame.z: +z up from the ground; roof at z = 0.16

configuration.scale_note: model scale; Eddy3D solves it at 1:100 (H = 20 m) with the tunnel velocities

units.length: m (model scale; converted from the published millimetres)

frame.origin: building centre on the ground plane
frame.x: +x streamwise (the wind at WD = 0 blows toward +x); slab spans x in [-0.025, 0.025]

cases.title: Case C — 3 × 3 block array
cases.summary: 3 x 3 array of 0.20 m cubes, centre block at 0D / 1D / 2D, pedestrian-height scalar speed (thermistor), 3 wind directions.

configuration.array: 3 x 3 cubes, D = 0.20 m, block centres at x, y in {-0.4, 0, +0.4} m (pitch 0.40 m = 2D, street width D)

centre_building.1D: 0.2 x 0.2 x 0.2 m (same as the surroundings)

configuration.configurations_note: 3 centre-building heights x 3 wind directions; all nine share the identical 120-point set
configuration.measurement_height_note: z = 0.1 D for every point (2.0 m at the 1:100 scale Eddy3D solves it at)
configuration.U_H_note: U at z = D = 0.20 m from AF_caseC.csv; the data paper states U_H = 3.65 m/s
configuration.instrument: thermistor anemometer (omnidirectional scalar speed), 1 Hz, 30 s per point; approach flow by I-type hot wire, 500 Hz, 30 s
configuration.tunnel: Technology Development Division, Fujita Corporation, Tokyo
configuration.pitch_note: The 0.40 m pitch is read from MP-z-caseC.png and Figure 3 of the data paper (street = D); the 120-point grid alone bounds the pitch to (0.35, 0.40] m (the 49 absent nodes of the 13 x 13 grid are exactly the nine footprints for 0.375 m as well as 0.40 m).

frame.origin: array centre on the ground plane (centre of the middle block)
frame.x: +x streamwise at WD = 0 (checked three ways on the data: y -> -y is a symmetry, the x <= -0.25 band is faster than x >= +0.25 in every configuration, and the regression slope of Vs is most negative within 0.8-4.3 deg of +x)

cases.title: Case D — high-rise among city blocks
cases.summary: 1:1:4 tower in a regular array of 82 low blocks, pedestrian-height scalar speed (thermistor, 3 wind directions) plus a 33-point split-fibre velocity field at WD = 0.

configuration.blocks: 82 blocks of 0.4H x 0.4H x 0.1H = 100 x 100 x 25 mm
configuration.roads: 0.1H / 0.2H / 0.3H = 25 / 50 / 75 mm; 9 columns in x (pitch alternating 175 / 150 mm), 11 rows in y (pitch 125 mm); corners cut by the turntable circle
configuration.scale: 1:400 (H = 100 m full scale; the 5 mm measurement plane = 2 m)
configuration.instrument: thermistor anemometer (78 points x 3 directions; 66 measured per direction, 12 points in the band around the tower unmeasured) and split-fibre probe (33 points at WD = 0: U, V, W, variances, k)
configuration.tunnel: see the data paper (Kikumoto et al. 2026, section 3.4)

units.length: m (model scale; converted from the workbook's millimetres)

frame.origin: tower centre on the ground plane (the array's bounding box is centred on it)
frame.x: +x streamwise at WD = 0 (the 0 deg thermistor field is exactly y-mirror symmetric; the split-fibre U is positive at the stream-like points and negative in the tower's windward horseshoe)

cases.title: Case E — Niigata district
cases.summary: Real district in Niigata at 1:250, before and after a 60 m high-rise and two 18 m mid-rises; pedestrian-height velocity ratio (thermistor), 16 wind directions.

configuration.district: Niigata City urban area near the Shinano River; dense low-rise stock (median top 6 m, max 30 m)

states.bc: before construction (sites of A, B, C empty)
states.ac: after construction of A (60 m high-rise), B and C (18 m mid-rises)

configuration.measurement_height_note: 2 m full scale = 0.008 m model scale
configuration.normalisation: velocity ratio = mean scalar speed at 2 m / inflow velocity at 15.9 m (the Niigata meteorological station height); U(15.9 m) = 0.504531 x UR = 3.935 m/s with UR = 7.8 m/s at ZR = 250 m
configuration.instrument: thermistor anemometer, 100 Hz, 60 s per point, mean scalar wind speed

frame.origin: centre of the reproduced area, ground plane

cases.title: Case F — Shinjuku district
cases.summary: Shinjuku sub-centre, Tokyo, November 1978: 1:800 tunnel (thermistor, 5 / 9 / 20 m) and a year of field cup anemometers; velocity ratio to the 500 m wind, 12 tunnel and 16 field directions.

configuration.district: Shinjuku sub-centre during construction of the high-rise group, building configuration of November 1978
configuration.model: terrain and buildings in a disc of radius 725 m (BD_caseF.stl; the readme and the data paper say 800 m / 1600 m diameter)
configuration.point_numbers: 1-3, 5-11, 13-15 (4 and 12 absent; points 16 and later belong to later construction stages and are not in the dataset)
configuration.normalisation: velocity ratio = mean speed / the approaching mean speed at the boundary-layer height 500 m (full scale); the field values were converted to it with the tunnel (readme). U(500 m) is 10 m/s in the data paper and 10.65 m/s implied by the profile
configuration.instrument: tunnel: thermistor anemometer, 30 s averaging; field: three-cup anemometer with wind vane, 10-minute means above 5 m/s at the reference roof, December 1977 - November 1978
configuration.tunnel: Shimizu Corporation wind tunnel; cross-section 1.55 m wide, 2.2 m high; power-law inflow, exponent 1/4

reference_roofs.SMB: Shinjuku-Mitsui Building, roof G.L.+210 m, anemometer G.L.+237 m, for NW-NE
reference_roofs.KDD: KDD Building, roof G.L.+165 m, anemometer G.L.+187 m, for the other directions

frame.origin: centre of the reproduced district, tunnel floor plane
frame.z: +z up from the TUNNEL FLOOR; the readme's rule is ground = z - 10 m (the STL's terrain under the points is at z = 5 m)

cases.title: Case G — flow behind a tree belt
cases.summary: Field observation behind the Tsuiji-matsu tree belt (a porous windbreak, 74 m × 2 m × 7 m with a 1.2 m gap below): normalised mean speed and k at 28 points on the centre section (sonic anemometers).

configuration.belt: Tsuiji-matsu (Japanese black pine), trimmed to a rectangle; 74 m long (y), 2 m deep (x), 7 m tall, 1.2 m bottom gap; shading rate 81 % after pruning (data paper section 3.7)
configuration.location: Taisha-machi, Hikawa-gun, Shimane, Japan; west end of an elementary-school playground
configuration.instrument: 3-D ultrasonic anemometers (KAIJO DA-600 with TR-90Tx) at four heights on a movable tower, 5 Hz, 10 min or more per line (26 Dec 2000); approach flow 120 min (28 Dec 2000) at 1.5, 3, 6, 9 m
configuration.normalisation: velocity_ratio = U/UH and k_ratio = k/UH^2, UH = the mean wind speed at 7 m during each measurement period (interpolated with the approach flow's power law, index 0.22); nothing is published in m/s
configuration.approach_flow_normalisation: AF_caseG.csv is U/Ub and k/Ub^2 with Ub = U at 9 m; divide by UH/Ub = 0.946 (power law 0.22) for the table's normalisation
configuration.scale_note: full scale: a field observation, there is no model

frame.origin: the leeward face of the tree belt at ground level, on the vertical section through the belt's centre
frame.x: +x downwind: the belt occupies x in [-2, 0] m, the measurement lines lie behind it at x = 1.75 ... 35 m
frame.y: +y along the belt (y in [-37, 37] m); every point is on y = 0
frame.z: +z up; the belt spans z in [1.2, 7] m; points at z = 1.5, 3, 4.5, 6 m

cases.title: Case H — 1:1:2 building with a floor point source
cases.summary: Isolated 1:1:2 building with an ethylene point source on the floor behind it: velocity (split-fibre hot wire) and concentration (hydrocarbon analyser) at 876 points.

configuration.U_H_note: the workbook's uH; the readme and the data paper state 3.23 m/s; the workbook's free-stream reference U0 is 5.279 m/s
configuration.source: 4 mm hole in the floor 0.25 H = 0.05 m behind the leeward face at (0.05, 0, 0); ethylene (C2H4), 100 %, 350 cc/min = 5.83e-6 m3/s
configuration.reference_concentration: c0 = cgas q / (UH H^2) = 45.18 ppm (45.2 in the paper); concentration_ratio = C / c0
configuration.instrument: velocity: constant-temperature anemometer (DANTEC 90C10) with a split-fibre probe (55R55, 55R56, 55R57), 1000 Hz, 120 s; concentration: high-speed total hydrocarbon analyser, 1000 Hz, 120 s
configuration.tunnel: Eiffel-type boundary-layer wind tunnel, Tokyo Polytechnic University, Atsugi (1.0 m high, 1.2 m wide)
configuration.scale_note: model scale; the source states no model:full-scale ratio; Eddy3D solves it at 1:100

frame.origin: the centre of the building's leeward face on the ground plane
frame.x: +x streamwise (the wind blows toward +x); the building spans x in [-0.1, 0]; points at x = -0.2 ... 0.4 m
frame.y: +y lateral; the building spans y in [-0.05, 0.05]; the z = 1/16 H plane covers y in [-0.2, 0.2]
frame.z: +z up; roof at z = 0.2 m; points at z = 0.01 ... 0.3 m

cases.title: Case I — cube with a roof point source
cases.summary: Isolated cube with an ethane point source at the centre of its roof: velocity (laser Doppler, 91 points) and concentration (hydrocarbon analyser, 539 points).

configuration.building: cube, 0.10 m on a side (= H)
configuration.U_H_note: the readme and the velocity sheet; the approach flow at z = H is 1.6969 m/s and the workbook's inflow sheet divides by 1.697

frame.origin: the centre of the cube on the ground plane
frame.x: +x streamwise (the wind blows toward +x); the cube spans x in [-0.05, 0.05]; wind points x = -0.15 ... 0.25 m, concentration points x = 0.065 ... 2.7 m

cases.title: Case J — 1:1:2 building, non-isothermal
cases.summary: Isolated 1:1:2 building with a floor tracer source in an unstably stratified boundary layer: velocity, temperature, tracer concentration and their turbulent fluxes at 444 points on three planes.

configuration.building: 1:1:2 (width : depth : height) prism, b = 0.08 m, H = 2b = 0.16 m
configuration.stratification: unstable: heated floor 45.8 degC, air at z = H 12.2 degC (difference 33.6 K), bulk Richardson number -0.086; building surface 22.0 .. 28.9 degC (mean 24.5 degC, 121 points in clean/cases/J/surface_temperature.csv)
configuration.source: 5 mm floor outlet at (0.04, 0, 0), 0.25 H beyond the leeward wall; 5 % ethylene in air at 30.4 degC, 9.17e-6 m3/s
configuration.concentration_normalisation: c0 = 0.05 q / (U_H H^2) = 12.283 ppm (the workbook's value; the 5 % gas fraction is in it)
configuration.instrument: split-fibre hot wire (velocity), cold wire (temperature), high-speed hydrocarbon analyser (concentration), 1000 Hz, 120 s per point
configuration.tunnel: thermally stratified wind tunnel, Tokyo Polytechnic University (Atsugi); 1.2 m wide, 1.0 m high
configuration.scale_note: model scale; the sources state no model:full scale ratio

units.temperature: degC (T); K (T_rms); heat fluxes K m/s

frame.origin: the building's leeward (downwind) wall centre on the ground; x = 0 is the leeward wall
frame.x: +x streamwise (the wind blows toward +x); the building spans x in [-0.08, 0]; the floor source is at x = +0.04
frame.y: +y lateral; the building spans y in [-0.04, 0.04]; the z/H = 0.025 plane is measured on the y <= 0 side only
frame.z: +z up; roof at z = 0.16; heated floor at z = 0

cases.title: Case M — TPU Atsugi campus
cases.summary: Tracer-gas release on the Tokyo Polytechnic University Atsugi campus: 1:600 tunnel (velocity at 180°, ethylene concentration at 175°, 180° and 185°) and 18 field runs with PMCH, 15 points 3 m above ground.

configuration.site: Tokyo Polytechnic University, Atsugi campus; terrain falls from about 32 m (campus plateau) to 3.6 m at the east edge; tallest building about 32 m
configuration.measurement_height_note: 3 m above the local ground, full scale (0.005 m model)
configuration.field_wind_directions_deg: 78 ... 200.7 (mean direction at the reference point per run); 11 of 18 within 5° of 180°

reference.R: rooftop of the main building: the point is 41 m above the ground, 8 m above the roof in the STL

tracer.tunnel: C2H4, 100 %, 6 mm outlet, 150 cc/min = 2.5e-6 m3/s (0.09 m/s)
tracer.field: PMCH (C7F14), 200 ppm, 5 L/min, 1.5 m above ground, 25-26 Feb 2014, 18 runs of 10 min sampling

configuration.normalisation: concentration ratio = C / c0, c0 = q / (U_R H_R^2): 132.5 ppm in the tunnel (the paper rounds to 1.33e2); per run in the field (1,444 ... 7,379 ppq)
configuration.instrument: tunnel: DANTEC split-fibre probe (1000 Hz, 240 s) and high-speed hydrocarbon analyser; field: sorbent tubes with GC-ECD, sonic anemometer SAT-600 at the reference point
configuration.tunnel: Eiffel-type boundary-layer wind tunnel, Tokyo Polytechnic University; cross-section 1.0 m high, 1.2 m wide; power law exponent 0.27 (AIJ Loads category IV) with an upwind taper for the topography

frame.origin: centre of the tunnel turntable on the floor plane (ground surface there at z = 33.07 m)
frame.y: +y WEST (compass rose of MP_caseM.png: N at +x, W at +y); the frame is right-handed
frame.z: +z up from the TUNNEL FLOOR; the campus ground lies at z ~ 32 m
